3d-arsham-eroded.name: Arsham eroded-sculpture 3D
3d-arsham-eroded.oneLine: Daniel Arsham's signature **eroded-relic** style - classical sculpture forms (Greco-Roman busts, classical drapery, modern objects) decayed as if unearthed centuries from now, with **crystals, calcite, selenite, or volcanic ash** emerging from the broken interiors. Monochrome base (chalk-white, ash-grey, blue calcite, or bronze) with metallic or crystalline accent revealing through the erosion. Speaks to "future relic" / time-decay / archaeology-of-the-now. Used for high-end fashion (Dior x Arsham), luxury crypto, gallery work, gravitas tech-marketing.

3d-crypto-gold-chrome.name: Crypto gold-chrome 3D (Bitcoin / token coin)
3d-crypto-gold-chrome.oneLine: Bitcoin, Ethereum, generic crypto coin or token symbols rendered as **polished gold or chrome 3D objects** - often floating mid-frame with a soft drop-shadow, sometimes with a circular halo / neon ring / rim-light. Saturated luxury palette. Used for DeFi product launches, NFT marketing, crypto-exchange hero shots, token-presale pages, web3 brand decks. The "money is shiny and the future is shiny too" register.

3d-dreamscape-terrain.name: 3D dreamscape terrain
3d-dreamscape-terrain.oneLine: Idealized rolling landscape rendered soft - velvet hills, cotton clouds, glassy water - a Windows-Bliss world rebuilt in gentle 3D.
3d-dreamscape-terrain.notForUseWhen: Brief needs gritty realism or hard-tech credibility - the terrain is idealized and soft.

3d-fur-rendered-mascot.name: Fur-rendered mascot 3D (Pixar Sully-grade)
3d-fur-rendered-mascot.oneLine: Pixar-Monsters-Inc-grade simulated fur - characters and objects rendered with **millions of individually-simulated hairs**, soft cuddly volume, big-fluffy-touchable form. The "warm hug" / "I want to pet it" register. Sully from Monsters Inc has 2.3M hairs (5.5M in Monsters University) - that's the benchmark. Used for friendly-tech mascots, kids' brands, soft-luxury skincare, anywhere you want a character that feels touchable through the screen.

3d-inflatable-balloon.name: Inflatable balloon 3D (Wannathis-grade)
3d-inflatable-balloon.oneLine: Characters, objects and even typography rendered as if **inflated like beach balls or pool toys** - high-gloss specular highlights, visible seam-marks where the panels meet, hovering soft shadows underneath, plump round volumes squashed slightly by their own weight. The Wannathis-Inflatable / Apple-Vision-marketing / Dribbble-2024-2026 register.
3d-inflatable-balloon.notForUseWhen: brutalism, restrained editorial, dark themes, B2B-serious

3d-knit-yarn-character.name: Knit / yarn 3D character (cozy wool)
3d-knit-yarn-character.oneLine: Characters and objects modeled to look like they're **knitted from wool, crocheted from yarn, or felted from raw fiber** - visible stitch pattern repeating across the surface, soft fiber-fuzz at the silhouette edges, slight stitch-row imperfections that read as "made by hand." Cozy / craft / slow-living register. Distinct from `illust-claymation-stop-motion` (clay surface), `illust-3d-fur-rendered-mascot` (simulated fur), and `illust-3d-plush-toy-soft` (fabric-stuffed with seams) - knit-yarn is FIBRE-STITCH with visible loops.

3d-miniature-diorama.name: 3D miniature diorama world
3d-miniature-diorama.oneLine: A tiny self-contained world - floating island, zen garden, micro-village - rendered in soft 3D with toy-scale charm.
3d-miniature-diorama.notForUseWhen: Brief needs gravitas, luxury, or enterprise seriousness - miniatures read charming.

3d-premium-product-hero.name: Premium product hero 3D (Apple / Ledger-Stax-grade)
3d-premium-product-hero.oneLine: Apple-product-marketing-grade premium device hero render - the **Apple Vision Pro / Apple Watch Ultra / Ledger Stax / Framework laptop** treatment. Sleek minimal device on a plain backdrop (gradient or pure white/black) with dramatic single key-light, accurate hi-fidelity material rendering (brushed aluminum + curved glass + leather strap + e-ink screen + chamfered edges), studio product-photography vibe. Distinct from `illust-3d-tron-emissive-glow` (which adds glow accents) - this entry is WITHOUT glow; **premium materials + dramatic lighting** do the work. The "luxury device speaks for itself" register.
3d-premium-product-hero.notForUseWhen: cottagecore, brutalism, kids brands, hand-made craft

3d-ps1-low-poly.name: PS1-era low-poly 3D
3d-ps1-low-poly.oneLine: Characters, objects, and environments rendered in the **PlayStation-1-era low-poly aesthetic** - angular silhouettes, low-resolution texture maps (256×256 for hero, 128×128 for everything else), vertex-jitter / wobble (because the PS1 had no subpixel precision), flat-shaded planes, no antialiasing, affine texture mapping (textures warp on tilted faces). Used for retro-game revival, nostalgic gaming brands, demoscene-adjacent work, vaporwave hybrids, indie-game marketing.

3d-spline-bubbly-product.name: Spline-era browser-3D bubbly product
3d-spline-bubbly-product.oneLine: The Spline / Vercel / Stripe / Linear-era browser-3D hero aesthetic - soft volumetric blobs, glossy plastic spheres, iridescent holographic gradients, interactive 3D shapes that float, morph, and respond to scroll/pointer. The 2022-2026 dev-tools / AI-product / fintech landing-page register.

3d-technical-exploded-precision.name: Technical exploded-view precision 3D
3d-technical-exploded-precision.oneLine: The internals of a device rendered as a **3D exploded-view technical illustration** - components floating apart in their assembly relationships (PCB, battery, antenna, sensor array, mechanical chassis, screws), often with **hairline label-lines** connecting components to small annotations or product-spec text. Clean grey/white backdrop, sharp directional studio shadow, no environment clutter. Engineering / precision / "look how it's built" register. Distinct from generic 3D product render in that the WHOLE is taken APART to make the assembly legible.

3d-tron-emissive-glow.name: Tron-emissive glow 3D (clean dark + glowing accents)
3d-tron-emissive-glow.oneLine: Clean dark 3D objects - hardware devices, abstract geometric forms, sci-fi props - with **glowing emissive lines or panel-edges** as deliberate accents. The Tron-Lines aesthetic. The object is otherwise dark monochrome (matte black, gunmetal, anodised carbon) and geometrically precise; the glow is the SINGLE highlight that does the talking. Always on dark backdrop so the emissive really pops. Distinct from gritty cyberpunk (which is weathered, decay-y) - this is GEOMETRIC-CLEAN cyberpunk, the Apple-Vision-Pro-promo / NVIDIA-RTX / Tron-Legacy register.
3d-tron-emissive-glow.notForUseWhen: cottagecore, warm-lifestyle, restrained-clean editorial, kids brands

antique-cartography.name: Antique nautical cartography
antique-cartography.oneLine: a full chart drawing system: rhumb lines, hatched coasts, compass roses, sepia ink on stained vellum.
antique-cartography.notForUseWhen: clinical modern UI, neon futurism, minimal flat SaaS

antique-engraving-etch.name: Antique engraving etch
antique-engraving-etch.oneLine: dense crosshatched pen scenes at old printing-plate density, ink black on cream.
antique-engraving-etch.notForUseWhen: friendly SaaS, candy-color kids brands, minimal flat design

arcane-painterly-hybrid.name: Arcane painterly 2.5D hybrid (Fortiche)
arcane-painterly-hybrid.oneLine: Netflix's *Arcane* (Riot Games + **Fortiche Productions**, 2021 / 2024) - the canonical reference for **hand-painted texture over 3D geometry**, the so-called **"2.5D hybrid"**. The signature is **manually painted textures (Photoshop) wrapped onto Autodesk Maya 3D models**, with painterly highlights, shadows, brushstrokes and imperfections baked into texture maps - every frame reflects emotional and artistic intent rather than procedural uniformity. The result reads as both 3D (volume, motion, depth) AND 2D (visible brushwork, painterly shading, hand-drawn line accents).

architectural-section-poche.name: Architectural section poche
architectural-section-poche.oneLine: precise drafted building section: hard black poche fills, annotation leaders and sun-shaft overlays as ornament.
architectural-section-poche.notForUseWhen: playful kids brands, maximalist pop, grunge, cartoon registers

bauhaus-geometric.name: Bauhaus pure geometric
bauhaus-geometric.oneLine: primary geometric shapes - circle, square, triangle.

bioluminescent-creature.name: Bioluminescent creature render
bioluminescent-creature.oneLine: A translucent deep-sea or fantastical organism - jellyfish, medusa, glowing totem-being - self-lit against true black, tendrils trailing.
bioluminescent-creature.notForUseWhen: Brief is warm-domestic, budget, or daylight - the creature lives in expensive darkness.

blush-cool-kids.name: Cool Kids
blush-cool-kids.oneLine: bold abstract patterns on clothing (checkerboard, stripes, dots).
blush-cool-kids.notForUseWhen: enterprise, serious finance, restrained AI marketing

blush-corporate-memphis-energetic.name: Corporate-Memphis Energetic Action (Blush)
blush-corporate-memphis-energetic.oneLine: Bright-palette mid-action flat-vector characters - bouncy, dope, doing hobbies, group celebration. Merges Blush's Happy-Bunch / Hobbies / Shiny-Happy families. Distinct from the Scenes variant (muted, single-prop, everyday-quiet) by saturation and motion energy.

blush-corporate-memphis-scenes.name: Corporate-Memphis Everyday Scenes (Blush)
blush-corporate-memphis-scenes.oneLine: Flat-vector everyday-life scenes - characters going about daily activity (office, park, walking, shopping, family moments) on a simple single-prop background. Merges Blush's Allura / Big-Shoes / Dayflow / Family-Values / Shopaholics families.

blush-croods.name: Croods
blush-croods.oneLine: vibrant bold-color characters with strong expressive faces.

blush-currency-crush.name: Currency Crush
blush-currency-crush.oneLine: cute stylized cash, coins, cards as flat icons.

blush-fancy-plants.name: Fancy Plants
blush-fancy-plants.oneLine: hand-painted plants in terracotta or ceramic pots.

blush-humaaans.name: Humaaans
blush-humaaans.oneLine: rigid geometric torso + modular limbs that snap together.

blush-hyperspace.name: Hyperspace
blush-hyperspace.oneLine: retro-futurist space doodles: rockets, planets, astronauts.

blush-isometric-stickers-vega.name: Blush Isometric Stickers (Mariana Gonzalez Vega)
blush-isometric-stickers-vega.oneLine: everyday isometric objects with white halo.

blush-little-things.name: The Little Things
blush-little-things.oneLine: cozy small joys: coffee, books, popcorn.

blush-moneyverse.name: Moneyverse
blush-moneyverse.oneLine: money/finance objects in cosmic context (bitcoins flying through space).

blush-open-peeps.name: Open Peeps
blush-open-peeps.oneLine: all forms drawn with 4-6px wobbly black brush line.
blush-open-peeps.notForUseWhen: cinematic 3D contexts, brutalism, dense data UI

blush-palz.name: Palz
blush-palz.oneLine: modern characters with fun colors + simple abstract shape accents.

blush-power-moves.name: Power Moves
blush-power-moves.oneLine: bright colors, bold patterns, fierce style.

blush-transhumans.name: Transhumans (Pablo Stanley - punk-zine cyborg ink)
blush-transhumans.oneLine: Pablo Stanley's open-source **Transhumans** collection (transhumans.xyz, also on Blush.design) - characters transcending biological limits with cyborg parts, reflective visors, robot heads, mechanical accessories. The actual aesthetic is **punk-zine ink**: bold brush strokes drawn quickly and imperfectly, **stark black and white** base with optional color overlays (the Blush coloring system layers tints on top). Inspired by 80s sci-fi cinema, kawaii minimalism, Japanese illustration, and the literal transhumanism movement. CC0 open-source.

blush-tutto-ricco.name: Tutto Ricco
blush-tutto-ricco.oneLine: sleek confident characters with bouncy pink dogs.

blush-wavy-buddies.name: Wavy Buddies
blush-wavy-buddies.oneLine: everything is a wavy curving line - limbs, hair, shadows.

blush-yuppies.name: Yuppies
blush-yuppies.oneLine: polished modern characters with relatable office scenes.

bollywood-painted-poster.notForUseWhen: minimal SaaS, clinical dashboards, quiet luxury, pastel friendliness

botanical-engraving.oneLine: fine hatched specimen plates with muted natural hand-color on warm cream.
botanical-engraving.notForUseWhen: loud maximalism, tech dashboards, neon nightlife brands

brick-instruction-diagram.notForUseWhen: moody atmospheric brands, painterly editorial, luxury, organic hand-drawn looks

drawkit-bubbly-tech-ui.oneLine: tech objects (laptops, phones, cards) rendered as inflated bubble forms.

drawkit-hands-3d.oneLine: anatomically simplified but realistically lit hand renders.
drawkit-hands-3d.notForUseWhen: cartoon contexts, brutalism, dense data UI

drawkit-isometric-stickers.oneLine: everyday objects (laptop, coffee, book) in true 2:1 isometric.
drawkit-isometric-stickers.notForUseWhen: editorial magazine, brutalism, dark cinematic UI

drawkit-jelly-3d.notForUseWhen: dense Bloomberg-style data UI, brutalist or editorial layouts

drawkit-wooden-icons.oneLine: hand-carved beech / pine grain visible on every surface.

dreamcore-liminal.name: Dreamcore liminal scene
dreamcore-liminal.oneLine: faded photo of empty mundane space (hallway, pool, mall).

enchanted-forest-glow.name: Enchanted forest glow
enchanted-forest-glow.oneLine: Twilight woodland lit from within - lanterns, fireflies, glowing flora - deep teal darkness held back by pools of warm magical light.
enchanted-forest-glow.notForUseWhen: Brief is rational, corporate, or daylight-honest - the register is twilight wonder.

eric-carle-tissue-collage.name: Eric Carle tissue-paper collage
eric-carle-tissue-collage.oneLine: subjects assembled from torn painted tissue paper.

expressionist-woodcut.name: German Expressionist woodcut
expressionist-woodcut.oneLine: jagged knife-slashed figures and letterforms, one poison hue against black.
expressionist-woodcut.notForUseWhen: calm wellness brands, pastel kids products, corporate trust marketing

fluffy-plush-3d.name: 3D Fluffy / Plush
fluffy-plush-3d.oneLine: long fiber fur shader covering the whole form.

folk-papercut-wycinanki.name: Folk papercut wycinanki
folk-papercut-wycinanki.oneLine: symmetric layered paper cutouts of roosters and flowers with scalloped scissor edges.
folk-papercut-wycinanki.notForUseWhen: dark tech, brutalist rawness, corporate dashboards

gouache-storybook.name: Modern gouache storybook
gouache-storybook.oneLine: opaque matte gouache layered blocky color.

halftone-shape.name: Halftone retro shape
halftone-shape.oneLine: circle / arc / wave with halftone-dot fill.

hand-drawn-pencil-sketch.name: Pencil graphite sketch
hand-drawn-pencil-sketch.oneLine: HB-to-6B graphite range on cream paper.

handyarrows-illustration.name: HandyArrows - Single-hand illustration pack (Eren Can Arica)
handyarrows-illustration.oneLine: The entire HandyArrows library - arrows, doodles, full illustrations, infographic accents, underlines - drawn by one hand (Eren Can Arica / Eronred). Single artist, single marker, consistent wobble, one entry to rule them all. Promptable per sub-asset role (arrow / doodle / illustration / infographic / underline).
handyarrows-illustration.notForUseWhen: dense data UI, brutalism, corporate Fortune-500

hilma-af-klint-symbolist.name: Hilma af Klint esoteric symbolism
hilma-af-klint-symbolist.oneLine: geometric forms with spiritual symbolic meaning.

humanities-marginalia.name: Humanities (medieval-marginalia revival)
humanities-marginalia.oneLine: quirky hand-drawn characters echoing medieval-manuscript marginalia.

ink-wash-atmosphere.name: Ink-wash atmosphere field
ink-wash-atmosphere.oneLine: Monochrome sumi-e cloud and sky fields - billowing ink masses, graded washes, paper breathing through - as hero atmosphere rather than subject.
ink-wash-atmosphere.notForUseWhen: Brief is playful-bright or vector-crisp - the wash is contemplative and tonal.

jean-jullien-thick-line.name: Jean Jullien thick brush cartoon
jean-jullien-thick-line.oneLine: thick black brush stroke (8-10px) outlining everything.

keith-haring-radiant.name: Keith Haring radiant pop
keith-haring-radiant.oneLine: thick uniform black lines defining all forms.

lofi-contemplative.name: Lo-fi contemplative scene
lofi-contemplative.oneLine: A solitary figure at rest in a vast quiet scene - dusk meadow, rooftop, window desk - rendered in the lo-fi-beats illustration tradition.
lofi-contemplative.notForUseWhen: Brief is energetic, corporate, or urgency-driven - the whole register is exhale.

loteria-folk-card.name: Loteria folk card
loteria-folk-card.oneLine: flat engraved-line icons in numbered card frames, fiesta color and carnival woodtype.
loteria-folk-card.notForUseWhen: somber minimalism, cold enterprise software, luxury restraint

low-poly-paper-3d.name: Low-Poly Paper Craft 3D
low-poly-paper-3d.oneLine: faceted polygon surfaces like a paper Pepakura model.

lowbrow-kustom-kulture.name: Lowbrow kustom kulture
lowbrow-kustom-kulture.oneLine: candy-metalflake hot-rod monster art with pinstripe lacquer flourishes and hand-lettered showman script.
lowbrow-kustom-kulture.notForUseWhen: corporate trust surfaces, fintech, minimal editorial, quiet luxury

mary-blair-stylized.name: Mary Blair stylized mid-century
mary-blair-stylized.oneLine: 2D stylized characters with bold non-naturalistic color.

monochrome-set-design.name: Monochrome set-design still life
monochrome-set-design.oneLine: A single-hue 3D prop stage - pink room with pink objects, blue world of blue toys - physical-set-design energy in render form.
monochrome-set-design.notForUseWhen: Brief needs realism or documentary trust - the staged set reads art-directed and brand-forward.

nature-meets-ui.name: Nature-meets-UI interpenetration
nature-meets-ui.oneLine: Interface elements physically hosting plant life - topiary growing out of stat cards, vines threading through a dashboard, moss on a button.
nature-meets-ui.notForUseWhen: Brief needs literal product screenshots untouched - this style ALTERS the interface with growth.

noir-comic-ink.name: Noir comic ink
noir-comic-ink.oneLine: High-contrast black-and-white ink illustration - brush splatter, dramatic spot blacks, hard-boiled narrative panels.
noir-comic-ink.notForUseWhen: Brief is cheerful, pastel, kid-friendly, or corporate-safe - noir ink carries grit.

origami-paper-3d.name: Origami / Folded Paper 3D
origami-paper-3d.oneLine: subject built from folded paper planes.

overwatch-stylized-pbr.name: Overwatch stylized-PBR hero (Blizzard)
overwatch-stylized-pbr.oneLine: Blizzard's *Overwatch* (2016 + 2023 Overwatch 2) - the canonical reference for **Pixar-grade stylized 3D applied to a real-time game engine**. The signature is **stylized PBR (Physically Based Rendering)** - PBR materials with disciplined art-direction constraints on saturation, value, and geometry. Plus **exaggerated character silhouettes** so readable they can be identified at any distance by pose alone (Reinhardt's hammer, Lúcio's headphones, D.Va's mech profile, Tracer's leggings - all silhouette anchors that read at any pose, any distance).

painterly-mythic-creature.name: Painterly mythic creature
painterly-mythic-creature.oneLine: A phoenix, stag, serpent, or spirit-bird rendered in loose expressive brushwork - gesture over anatomy, drama in the strokes.
painterly-mythic-creature.notForUseWhen: Brief is technical, minimal, or photoreal - the creature is expressive brushwork, not asset-render.

papercraft-diorama-world.name: Papercraft diorama world
papercraft-diorama-world.oneLine: A whole navigable scene built from visible cut paper - layered card hills, folded houses, tab-and-slot trees - craft-table charm at world scale.
papercraft-diorama-world.notForUseWhen: Brief is premium-sleek or serious-enterprise - paper reads handmade and playful.

particle-figure.name: Particle-formed figure
particle-figure.oneLine: A creature, object, or figure materializing from thousands of glowing particles - half-dissolved between dust and form.
particle-figure.notForUseWhen: Brief is warm, organic, handcrafted, or budget - particles read high-tech and cold.

pixar-coco-folk-vibrant.name: Pixar Coco folk-vibrant Land of the Dead
pixar-coco-folk-vibrant.oneLine: Pixar's *Coco* (2017, Lee Unkrich) - the canonical reference for **Mexican folk-art vocabulary applied to Pixar-grade 3D**. The signature is the **Land of the Dead** - *"a vibrant explosion of color"* (Unkrich's brief) - with the **marigold-petal bridge** literally connecting worlds, **calaveras** (sugar-skull face paint motifs) etched around eyes and chin, **alebrijes** (psychedelic spirit-animal folk sculptures) as spiritual guides, and **papel picado** (cut-paper banners) as decorative architecture. The whole afterlife is built like a glowing, tiered, ever-expanding folk-art cathedral.

pixar-elemental-translucent.name: Pixar Elemental translucent-material
pixar-elemental-translucent.oneLine: Pixar's *Elemental* (2023, Peter Sohn) - the canonical reference for **characters MADE of their element**, with full material-physics simulation. Ember (fire) is **self-illuminating** - she **lights the scene as a light source**. Wade (water) is **refractive and reflective**. Pixar built "Pixar's most fully simulated character" for Ember - physics + cartoony appeal - with **151,000 computers** required to render the film; every frame has at least one (often both) fire and water simulations.

pixar-inside-out-emotion-volumetric.name: Pixar Inside Out emotion-volumetric
pixar-inside-out-emotion-volumetric.oneLine: Pixar's *Inside Out* (2015, Pete Docter) - the canonical reference for **abstract emotions personified as volumetric particle-bodies**. The signature is the emotion characters: Joy, Sadness, Fear, Disgust, Anger - each rendered with a **body surface beneath a volumetric particle aura** that radiates outward from skin. Joy's particles emanate most (her wrist is **transparent** - Docter wanted to show "the characters are made of energy"), Anger is the most solid, Sadness/Fear sit between. The **emotion-color → memory-orb** vocabulary became universal shorthand.

pixar-soul-great-before-pastel.name: Pixar Soul Great-Before pastel-abstract
pixar-soul-great-before-pastel.oneLine: Pixar's *Soul* (2020, Pete Docter + Kemp Powers) - the canonical reference for **abstract-spiritual character design**. The Great Before is the un-Earth-like soul-realm where new souls are prepared before birth, designed as **"deceptively simple, big bold beautiful shapes, abstract buildings unlike any on Earth."** The signature element: **the Counselors (the "Jerrys")** - flexible, "living" white **single-stroke lines** that contort like Picasso line drawings, can be literally anything because they're the universe dumbing itself down for humans to comprehend it. Pastel translucent souls float through soft pastel architecture. Earth scenes (NYC) are photoreal, contrasting the spiritual register sharply.
pixar-soul-great-before-pastel.notForUseWhen: brutalism, cyberpunk, gritty-documentary, kinetic-tech, dark themes

plasticine-3d-rougher.name: 3D Plasticine (rougher than clay)
plasticine-3d-rougher.oneLine: oilier surface than clay, more visible tool marks.

polish-poster-gouache.name: Polish School poster gouache
polish-poster-gouache.oneLine: dark expressive gouache where one symbolic image and hand-painted lettering share a single brush gesture.
polish-poster-gouache.notForUseWhen: cheerful consumer brands, kids products, clean tech marketing

pop-art-silkscreen-repeat.name: Pop art silkscreen repeat
pop-art-silkscreen-repeat.oneLine: the same portrait repeated in a serial grid, each pull drifting off register in fluoro duotones.
pop-art-silkscreen-repeat.notForUseWhen: cozy craft brands, pastoral calm, conservative corporate

pulp-cover-painted.name: Pulp cover painted noir
pulp-cover-painted.oneLine: mid-century paperback cover painting: brushed dramatic realism with tiered cover lines in taxi yellow and lipstick red.
pulp-cover-painted.notForUseWhen: family-friendly brands, healthcare, minimal corporate, kids content

push-pin-victorian-psychedelic.name: Push Pin Victorian psychedelic
push-pin-victorian-psychedelic.oneLine: Victorian circus display type paired with flat-color psychedelic flowing-figure illustration in a candy palette on cream.
push-pin-victorian-psychedelic.notForUseWhen: dark tech, brutalism, clinical dashboards, somber editorial

raster-cutout-collage.name: Raster cutout collage
raster-cutout-collage.oneLine: photo cutouts assembled into surreal scene.

retro-contraption-3d.name: Retro contraption 3D
retro-contraption-3d.oneLine: A whimsical invented machine - part typewriter, part computer, part appliance - rendered in friendly 3D with knobs, tubes, and personality.
retro-contraption-3d.notForUseWhen: Brief is sleek-premium or serious-enterprise - the machine is deliberately charming and clunky.

saul-bass-cutout.name: Saul Bass cutout collage
saul-bass-cutout.oneLine: bold cut-paper shapes with rough scissor edges.

scribbbles-funky-vector.name: Scribbbles funky vector scribble
scribbbles-funky-vector.oneLine: single-line abstract scribbles - squiggles, loops, tangles.

sculptural-3d-object.name: Sculptural 3D object
sculptural-3d-object.oneLine: One abstract gallery-grade form - a twisted ribbon, stacked discs, eroded stone, a perfect knot - single material, studio-lit, plinth-ready.

shinkai-hyperreal-anime.name: Makoto Shinkai hyperreal anime

skeuomorphic-detailed.oneLine: photoreal materials - leather stitch, brushed metal, wood grain.

solidarity-agitprop-flat.oneLine: tricontinental solidarity poster: symbolic flat figures and raised fists in three to four unmodulated silkscreen inks on cream.
solidarity-agitprop-flat.notForUseWhen: soft lifestyle brands, luxury, whimsical kids content, neutral corporate tone

spectrums-complex-flower.name: Spectrums - Complex / Flower
spectrums-complex-flower.oneLine: flower-like radial shapes, complex stars, mandala-adjacent forms.

spectrums-vector-shape-circle.name: Spectrums - Circle family
spectrums-vector-shape-circle.oneLine: clean geometric circles with variations: dotted, double-stroked, segmented.

spiderverse-comic-halftone.name: Spider-Verse comic-halftone (Sony Imageworks)
spiderverse-comic-halftone.oneLine: *Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse* (Sony Pictures Animation, 2018) - the canonical reference for **comic-book printing aesthetic baked into CG**. The signature is **Ben-Day dots, line hatching, halftone screens applied via custom crosshatch shaders** to entire 3D objects/characters/scenes (Sony built the **Hatcher** and **Thresher** tools in Nuke for this). Plus the famous **animating on twos** (12fps poses held over 24fps timeline) that gives it the staccato 2D-animation rhythm audiences subconsciously read as "comic book."

sticker-cutout-puffy.name: Sticker cutout puffy
sticker-cutout-puffy.oneLine: subject with white halo outline like die-cut sticker.

stylized-3d-avatar.name: Stylized 3D self-avatar
stylized-3d-avatar.oneLine: A Pixar-grade stylized 3D character portrait of a REAL person - the designer/founder as their own hero asset.
stylized-3d-avatar.notForUseWhen: Brief is corporate-formal, luxury, or anonymous-brand - a personal avatar centers an individual.

toyism-symbol-pop.name: Toyism symbol pop
toyism-symbol-pop.oneLine: hand-painted symbol-set pop: flat primary glyphs assembled from a shared vocabulary, with spray, brush and stamp paint textures.
toyism-symbol-pop.notForUseWhen: photoreal product marketing, luxury restraint, organic hand-drawn warmth

typo-art-nouveau-ornament.name: Art Nouveau ornamental lettering
typo-art-nouveau-ornament.oneLine: letterforms entwined with floral vines, buds, tendrils.

typo-blackletter-neo-gothic.name: Blackletter / Neo-Gothic illustrative
typo-blackletter-neo-gothic.oneLine: blackletter foundation with sharp ornate flourishes.

typo-chromeheart-gothic-luxury.name: Chrome-Hearts gothic-luxury blackletter
typo-chromeheart-gothic-luxury.oneLine: The Chrome Hearts brand identity - **Cloister Black** blackletter (Morris Fuller Benton, 1904 - Old English style) rendered in chrome / silver-jewelry finish, with crosses, daggers, fleur-de-lis, and occasional gemstone accents filling the counters. Streetwear-luxury register. The intersection of `illust-typo-blackletter-neo-gothic` (the raw blackletter form) and `illust-typo-y2k-chrome-3d` (the chrome-extruded treatment) - distinct from both because it commits to BOTH together as a coherent brand-bling identity.

typo-dry-brush-grunge.name: Dry-brush grunge display
typo-dry-brush-grunge.oneLine: Ragged dry-brush strokes doing the job of headline type - each letter a single fast pass of a starved brush, bristle streaks and broken edges left in. Ash white and ember orange on carbon black, with crackle and cinder texture soaking the whole frame. Fire-and-ash energy: the type looks scorched, not painted.
typo-dry-brush-grunge.notForUseWhen: friendly consumer onboarding, pastel wellness, precise fintech, kids products

typo-hand-lettered-editorial.name: Hand-lettered editorial (modern brush)
typo-hand-lettered-editorial.oneLine: bespoke brush lettering with confident smooth curves.

typo-letter-scatter.name: Letterform dispersal display
typo-letter-scatter.oneLine: Heavy monochrome display type whose glyphs break loose and scatter - letters dissolve off a word's trailing edge into flocks, streams and weather that literally depict the word's meaning. Type as image: RIVER's letters spill into a winding current of small glyphs, a bird word bursts into a flock.
typo-letter-scatter.notForUseWhen: dense data UI, long-form reading surfaces, playful candy-color branding

typo-massin-stage.name: Typographic theatre
typo-massin-stage.oneLine: Type performed as dialogue on a paper stage - every voice gets its own color, size and attack. The shouting character is a wall of towering rubber-stamped capitals slammed at an angle; the timid reply shrinks word by word, cascading down the page in perspective until it trails off into scattered characters. Speech made visible through scale, direction and ink pressure alone.
typo-massin-stage.notForUseWhen: calm reading apps, luxury restraint, data-dense dashboards, corporate reassurance

typo-signpainter-chalk.name: Victorian signpainter chalk
typo-signpainter-chalk.oneLine: Ornamented signpainter lettering on a near-black ground - gilded script with swash flourishes over chalk-textured small caps, framed by engraved rules, tickets and celestial ornament. The register of the Victorian shopfront and the tavern chalkboard at once.
typo-signpainter-chalk.notForUseWhen: tech-minimal, kinetic-loud youth brands, clinical SaaS dashboards

typo-vector-musica.name: Vector Música typographic illustration
typo-vector-musica.oneLine: music-festival poster lettering: chunky display + decorative motif.

typo-vectorheart-industrial-futurist.name: Vectorheart industrial-futurist (Designers Republic / Wipeout)
typo-vectorheart-industrial-futurist.oneLine: The mid-late-1990s Vectorheart aesthetic - vector typography rooted in Swiss modernism, utilitarian industrial design, brutalism, and Peter Saville's Factory Records covers. Pioneered by **Bionic Systems** and **The Designers Republic**. The Wipeout PSX game UI (designed by Designers Republic) is the canonical example - also known as "Wipeout Design." NOTHING to do with romantic heart-shapes; the "heart" is etymologically unrelated.

typo-weingart-deconstructed.name: Weingart deconstructed typography
typo-weingart-deconstructed.oneLine: letterforms stretched to extreme spacing, layered halftones.
typo-weingart-deconstructed.notForUseWhen: friendly consumer UI, kids, Y2K bling

typo-wildstyle-blackbook.name: Wildstyle blackbook marker
typo-wildstyle-blackbook.oneLine: Angular interlocked wildstyle graffiti lettering worked up in marker on sketchbook paper - the writer's blackbook register, not the finished wall.
